name: Hallusionbench
description: Hallusionbench is a diagnostic benchmark designed to evaluate image-context reasoning in large vision-language models, focusing on language hallucination and visual illusion challenges through 346 images and 1129 human-crafted questions.
reputation: A recent diagnostic multimodal benchmark that has gained attention for probing hallucination and illusion failures in vision-language models.
notes: Benchmark includes control groups for quantitative analysis of model response tendencies and failure modes such as hallucination and illusion.
